about: TASK-134 (voice spec §8 / §44). How Tushky's voice says portfolio terms. The speech normaliser (lib/tushky-voice/speech-text.ts) replaces each `term` (whole word, case-sensitive) with `say` in the SPOKEN transcript only; the displayed answer never changes. Only pronunciations that are certain live in `terms`. `unconfirmed` lists terms left to the model until Tushar confirms how they are said; they are NOT applied. A change here changes every affected answer's speech hash, so its pre-generated FAQ audio goes stale automatically.
